title: the component chart sieves read a berth charted on another box by its commons copy
intention: build_inspector's component chart sieves and forwarding_residue read a chart berth charted on another box by its commons copy, through chain.claiming_packets, so every box judges the same charts.
why: Law 7 and the one-reader rule of e8fb6bcd23c5: 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux, by /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cc/0/scratch/akiendelllinux_cc_0/skillseals/measure_globs.py: one orient berth claiming a component's active ticket, with an unresolvable ref. Stored in the local chart store, _charted_packets finds 1, charted_refs_resolve reds 1 and forwarding_residue leaves 1 pair unanswered. Stored only in the commons mirror, all three read 0, while chain.claiming_packet_paths finds it both ways. Live, 308 of the 3367 CairnCommons/berths/chart berths are absent from this box's store, across about 30 tickets, 7cae18f7f9c2 among them, so the Linux sealer's component sieves never judge those charts. cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:449 (_charted_packets, feeding charted_refs_resolve and every _judge_charted sieve) and :906 (forwarding_residue) glob _CHART_BERTHS alone. The fourth and fifth sites of one shape: 1e99a571dd6d (sail.verdict, PROVED), 7cae18f7f9c2 (the verdict gate) and 072a482e6dd7 (the BUILDME lane).
traces_to: RULE 1 (one reader, the chain tool's); Law 1 (the fourth and fifth sites of one settled shape)
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py: _charted_packets(comp_dir, stage) gathers its packets as the union over _component_tickets(comp_dir) of claiming_packets(tid, stage) (already imported from cairn.tools.chain.chain, which reads the local store, the mirror and every spelling, local copy first). Its unreadable list still comes from the local glob, as now. forwarding_residue(comp_dir) with a comp_dir reads its orient, constrain and survey packets the same way. forwarding_residue(None) keeps its local glob: a claimless berth is never carried, and listing every carried berth needs a chain-side reader, out of this component. cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_component_sieves_read_a_far_box_chart_by_its_commons_copy.py: one tooth per clause, a scratch local store and a scratch mirror swapped in as test_buildme_reads_a_far_box_chart_by_its_commons_copy.py does (chain.BERTHS_ROOT, chain._commons_mirror, inspector._CHART_BERTHS), in the shape of /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cc/0/scratch/akiendelllinux_cc_0/skillseals/measure_globs.py

clauses.claim: with a component's active ticket claimed by an orient berth held only in the commons mirror, _charted_packets returns it, and charted_refs_resolve reds its unresolvable ref exactly as it does for the same berth held locally
forwarding_residue(comp_dir) asks the same (address, ticket) pair for a mirror-only berth as for a local one
a berth held both locally and in the mirror is read once, and an unreadable local berth is still reported to the chart component as before

decisions.text: D1: _charted_packets and forwarding_residue(comp_dir) read through chain.claiming_packets; the unreadable scan stays local.
D2: red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_component_sieves_read_a_far_box_chart_by_its_commons_copy.py, one tooth per clause.
